column1: # FLY-1062 gate④: registered repo-access lines inside the release tree.
# EXACT-LINE semantics (review rounds R1-R4 killed every looser scheme): the
# registration must EQUAL the shipping line after po_g4_norm normalization
# (shell quotes stripped, whitespace squeezed, lowercased, trimmed), and must
# itself trigger the SAME detector as the occurrence it clears. Any other
# line carrying a forbidden shape fails the gate — a NEW or EDITED line must
# be re-registered here deliberately (snapshot discipline). Every row MUST
# have a behavioral test proving the customer path never exercises it
